name_en: Weak lower semicontinuity of convex functionals
category: differential equations / partial differential equations / functional analysis
canonical_claim: For a convex extended-real-valued functional on a real normed space, lower semicontinuity for the norm topology implies lower semicontinuity for the weak topology; together with the trivial converse this gives equivalence, subject to the codomain and properness conventions fixed from the selected primary source.
